page_title: VER 0-1 ACM | Verona v AC Milan 20/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Livio Marinelli has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' What a poor attempt! Tomas Suslov (Verona) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Ondrej Duda (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Livio Marinelli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch so that Emerson Royal can be given a rest.

87' This was a nice set play that lacked a finish. Unmarked Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) controlled a precise lofted pass from the corner kick and unleashed a long-range shot. He hit the ball very poorly, sending it miles of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
85' The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
83' The ball is out of play. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner.
83' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Verona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' Ondrej Duda (Verona) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Reda Belahyane walks off the pitch to be replaced by Casper Tengstedt (Verona).

80' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.

78' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
75' Looks like Davide Calabria (AC Milan) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
74' Rough tackle by Reda Belahyane (Verona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to AC Milan.
73' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Darko Lazovic will be replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
70' Substitution. Samuel Chukwueze is replaced by Davide Calabria (AC Milan).
69' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lorenzo Montipo reads it well and gathers the ball.
68' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Emerson Royal (AC Milan) inside the box. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' AC Milan are seeing far more of the ball now.
64' AC Milan take a short corner kick.

64' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' The ball possession is 29:71.
59' Here comes a substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Grigoris Kastanos.
59' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
56' 0 - 1 Goal! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is teed up on the edge of the box by Youssouf Fofana, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
55' Corner kick. Ondrej Duda (Verona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
54' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle as Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
47' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
46' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
46' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Dailon Rocha Livramento comes on the pitch for Amin Sarr (Verona).
46' Paolo Zanetti has made a change at the break. Flavius Daniliuc has come on in place of Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Livio Marinelli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' A pass lands at the feet of Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45+3' Livio Marinelli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ondrej Duda (Verona).
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
41' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

41' A dangerous attempt from Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a superb save and stops this one. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
37' AC Milan string together a series of short passes.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Theo Hernandez replaces him.
31' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

28' Tomas Suslov (Verona) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
25' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Livio Marinelli had an easy-decision to make.
24' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Lorenzo Montipo.
21' A pass by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
20' Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) sends an accurate short pass. Alejandro Jimenez controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
15' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Livio Marinelli no option but to blow his whistle.
13' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
11' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. AC Milan have a corner.
10' A mid-range free kick is awarded to AC Milan out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
8' Tomas Suslov (Verona) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
7' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) and Diego Coppola matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
4' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) commits a foul after dangerous play. Free kick. Verona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Verona will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
